lastVerified.scope: Every value the site uses. Each game update and hotfix since 1.4.2.5 had a raw before/after comparison; values reported unchanged keep their earlier provenance.
lastVerified.labelMeaning: A build named on a single value (sourceBuild, 'first read in' in damageSource, a build in an evidence file name) is the build that value was first read from, not the last build it was checked against. This record gives the last build checked.

sources.authority: Reviewed local Frosty baseline fields with per-weapon provenance. Creator corroboration applies to the historical 1.4.2.5 Interdictor curve, which the 1.4.3.0 source update supersedes.

sources.buildEvidence: user-supplied build label; executable hash and Frosty archive Head 4892017 recorded in the comparison
sources.authority: Reviewed Interdictor damage curve, hit-zone material and iron-sight cost, plus VSSM velocity and recoil changes. Retained values keep their 1.4.2.5 provenance; the source update does not establish native runtime formulas.

Raw before/after comparison of the 63 pre-existing weapons against 1.4.3.5. Applied: SVDM recoil direction 4 to 20 and recoil decrease time exponent 0.75 to 1.1; M39 EMR exponent 0.75 to 1.0; controller recoil multiplier 0.8836 to 0.95; VSSM 10 Rnd description. No other value used by the site changed for these weapons; retained values keep their earlier provenance. The four Season 5 weapons (Mk 24, ELR-40, Z84M, RSPR) were added from 2.1.1.0.
Declared mechanics and explicitly listed balance changes
sources.note: The 1.3.3.0 notes were the declared-mechanics source when the baseline was adopted. The Season 5 notes are recorded as ea-update-notes-2.1.1.0.

sources.authority: Declared Season 5 mechanics and listed balance changes, checked row by row against the 2.1.1.0 raw data in the update checklist. Notes do not supply internal coefficients or prove unmentioned fields.

sources.versionEvidence: Payload info.version and info.versionDate; full user-supplied JSON SHA-256 independently verified on 2026-09-09 against the recorded 2026-09-06 retrieval.
sources.authority: Base weapon fields and damage curves

dataPolicy.replacementRule: Replace a verified value only when a newer authoritative source or reviewed in-game evidence supersedes it.
